content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that reads an initial depth half-domain to derive a mirrored N=2n-1 grid (L2-L14), configures three frame indices and six tight subplot axes (L18-L31), loads eta/mask/concentration for each frame (L33-L41), masks and mirrors eta and concentration (L40-L47), and plots paired free-surface and log-concentration panels with per-panel colorbars (L53-L81).

io.name: paired eta and log concentration panels

unresolved: The subplot interface is coupled to the default vector length in three independent places: tight_subplot creates exactly 6 axes at L30, the loop follows length(nfile) at L33, and each iteration indexes two axes at L53 and L67. More than three nfile entries exceeds ha; fewer leave unused axes. The title also indexes the independent min cell array at L58.

All loop-loaded arrays at L36-L38 are assumed to have the n-by-m shape learned only from dep at L7. mask is immediately used to index eta and ch at L40-L41, and both are assigned into fixed ETA/CH slices at L44-L47 without shape checks.
The logarithm at L69 is evaluated without requiring CH>0. mask<1 handling at L41 only converts masked cells to NaN; unmasked zero values become -Inf and negative values become non-real before pcolor.
tight_subplot at L30 is an external helper with no availability check or fallback, so the complete plotting path depends on an undeclared interface.

The free-surface axes enable hold at L56 but never issue hold off. Each iteration uses a distinct default axis for the present three frames, but reuse or rerun in an existing figure can retain graphics unexpectedly.
